en.headline: AFCD demonstrates container fish farming system at Au Tau with triple the yield
en.dek: Three 20-foot containers at the Yuen Long fisheries office produce about three times the output of a traditional one-acre pond while recycling water through ecological ponds.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department is demonstrating a container-based ecological aquaculture system at its Au Tau fisheries office in Yuen Long, saying a single 20-foot container can deliver roughly three times the production of a traditional one-acre small fish pond.

Three standard containers are used for high-density rearing of fish such as jade perch and tilapia. Waste water is directed into four adjacent ecological ponds for sedimentation, filtration and oxygenation before being returned, allowing water reuse and providing habitat for birds and other wetland species.

The department said the system is fitted with sensors and a smart management platform that monitors water quality around the clock and issues alerts. Training for local fish farmers is planned for the next quarter, with support available through the Fisheries Development Fund for those interested in adopting the approach.

zh.headline: 漁護署凹頭示範集裝箱生態養魚 產量約傳統魚塘三倍
zh.dek: 元朗凹頭辦事處以三個20呎貨櫃進行高密度養殖，尾水經生態池塘淨化循環再用，並設智慧監測平台。
body: 漁農自然護理署在元朗凹頭漁業辦事處設立示範場地，展示集裝箱生態養殖系統。署方表示，一個20呎貨櫃的產量約相當於一畝傳統小型魚塘的三倍。
系統以三個標準貨櫃進行高密度養殖寶石魚及羅非魚等，養殖尾水排入四個相連生態池塘，經沉澱、過濾及增氧淨化後循環使用，同時為雀鳥及其他濕地生物提供生境。
系統配備感應器及智慧水產養殖管理平台，全日監察水質參數並可自動警報。漁護署計劃下季度為本地漁民提供培訓，有意轉型者亦可透過漁業發展基金申請支援。
